Planning, implementation, and legacy maintenance are all getting cheaper, making strategic fit—not technical feasibility—the defining choice.
As AI lowers planning, build and legacy run costs, choose buy versus build based on strategic fit, differentiation and ownership.

Needs are common across the market
Time-to-value outweighs customization

Fit gaps can force process compromise
Licensing and vendor roadmaps constrain change

Workflows create competitive advantage
Control of data, experience and roadmap matters

Requires durable product and engineering capability
Ownership includes ongoing maintenance
AI lowers cost at every stage of the modernization journey
Reduce run cost and reliance on scarce legacy skills

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: CORE MESSAGE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>CORE MESSAGE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.

nodes.text: The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: OFF-THE-SHELF ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>OFF-THE-SHELF ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.

nodes.text: Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The buyer benefits from that outside expertise and avoids building the core product. The tradeoff is that the platform normally must be configured, trimmed, integrated and tailored—and the organization often adapts its people, language, processes and data to the technology selected.

nodes.text: The buyer benefits from that outside expertise and avoids building the core product. The tradeoff is that the platform normally must be configured, trimmed, integrated and tailored—and the organization often adapts its people, language, processes and data to the technology selected.

The tradeoff is that the platform normally must be configured, trimmed, integrated and tailored—and the organization often adapts its people, language, processes and data to the technology selected.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: BUSINESS-FIT CUSTOM SOFTWARE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>BUSINESS-FIT CUSTOM SOFTWARE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.

nodes.text: A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Technology can be designed around the organization’s people and process rather than requiring the organization to adopt a vendor’s model. This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.

nodes.text: Technology can be designed around the organization’s people and process rather than requiring the organization to adopt a vendor’s model. This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.

This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: WHY REVISIT THE DECISION
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>WHY REVISIT THE DECISION</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Earlier buy-versus-build decisions were made when custom modernization required more time, specialized labor and cost. If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.

nodes.text: Earlier buy-versus-build decisions were made when custom modernization required more time, specialized labor and cost. If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>Earlier buy-versus-build decisions were made when custom modernization required more time, specialized labor and cost. If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: For CRM, ERP and other large enterprise capabilities, re-evaluate prior assumptions using current implementation cost, speed to value, organizational-change burden, lifecycle operations, risk and strategic value. Do not assume that yesterday’s answer remains the right answer.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The message is expanded buyer choice—not the demise of SaaS and not a universal preference for custom development. Off-the-shelf software remains compelling where vendor expertise, ecosystem scale, regulatory standards or common processes create value. Lower custom-build cost and lower change burden remain hypotheses to validate for each client and capability.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: CORE MESSAGE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>CORE MESSAGE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.

nodes.text: The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>The business is no longer forced to reshape itself around a single software model. Organizations can make a more informed capability-by-capability choice about where off-the-shelf enterprise software should lead and where technology should be built around the business.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: OFF-THE-SHELF ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>OFF-THE-SHELF ENTERPRISE SOFTWARE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.

nodes.text: Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>Large enterprise platforms such as CRM and ERP bring the expertise of a product company that may spend years refining workflows, data models and operating patterns for a function or industry.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The buyer benefits from that outside expertise and avoids building the core product. The tradeoff is that the platform normally must be configured, trimmed, integrated and tailored—and the organization often adapts its people, language, processes and data to the technology selected.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: BUSINESS-FIT CUSTOM SOFTWARE
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>BUSINESS-FIT CUSTOM SOFTWARE</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.

nodes.text: A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.

exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1100" /><ns0:t>A business-fit solution starts with the expertise inside the organization: the processes, practices, controls, customer experience and ways of working that have proved effective for that business.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Technology can be designed around the organization’s people and process rather than requiring the organization to adopt a vendor’s model. This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.

nodes.text: Technology can be designed around the organization’s people and process rather than requiring the organization to adopt a vendor’s model. This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.

This does not mean preserving every current process; modernization should still improve work that creates friction or limits performance.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: WHY REVISIT THE DECISION
exact_notes_paragraphs.xml: <ns0:p xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><ns0:r><ns0:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1200" b="1" /><ns0:t>WHY REVISIT THE DECISION</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: Earlier buy-versus-build decisions were made when custom modernization required more time, specialized labor and cost. If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.

nodes.text: Earlier buy-versus-build decisions were made when custom modernization required more time, specialized labor and cost. If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.

If AI-assisted analysis, prototyping, engineering, testing and maintenance materially reduce those costs, the economic threshold for a business-fit build changes.</ns0:t></ns0:r><ns0:endParaRPr lang="en-US" /></ns0:p>

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: For CRM, ERP and other large enterprise capabilities, re-evaluate prior assumptions using current implementation cost, speed to value, organizational-change burden, lifecycle operations, risk and strategic value. Do not assume that yesterday’s answer remains the right answer.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The message is expanded buyer choice—not the demise of SaaS and not a universal preference for custom development. Off-the-shelf software remains compelling where vendor expertise, ecosystem scale, regulatory standards or common processes create value. Lower custom-build cost and lower change burden remain hypotheses to validate for each client and capability.

exact_text_nodes: West Monroe modernization programs accelerate delivery, protect continuity, and lower operating effort
Three client stories show how focused modernization converts technical execution into measurable business outcomes.
A critical customer-facing application was assessed and rewritten in less than half the traditional timeline.
Strengthened security and restored a maintainable delivery path while reducing deadline and release risk.
A mission-critical interconnection platform was modernized across six operating companies without disrupting service.
Protected critical workflows, reduced cutover risk, and created a scalable foundation for future interconnection demand.
A legacy compliance platform was redesigned to deliver customer reports faster and at lower operating cost.
Reduced consultant effort, accelerated customer reporting, and established a scalable cloud platform for growth.
Illustrative West Monroe client outcomes; the 12-month comparison baseline is directional and should be validated before external use.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The client needed to modernize a decade-old solar interconnection solution supporting workflows across six operating companies. The program migrated more than 675,000 lines of code and modified more than 800 files. Business stakeholders validated feature parity, and the old and new interfaces ran side by side in production before final cutover. The value is protection of critical operations, improved maintainability and development efficiency, and reduced transition risk. The source does not report duration, program cost, cost savings, or a before-AI baseline.

exact_notes_paragraphs.text: The legacy on-premise platform had lengthy report-processing times, limited third-party integration, duplicated functionality, complex workflows, and security vulnerabilities. The redesigned cloud platform used AI/ML-enabled automation to simplify highly manual tasks. The reported result was a 65% reduction in total report-generation duration and more than $30,000 in average savings per customer based on consultant time saved. This is the strongest quantified business-value proof on the slide.

exact_text_nodes: Why complex modernization has historically been slow and expensive

Coding is only one part. The harder work is rediscovering how the business runs, deciding what should change, aligning operators and technical teams, cleaning and migrating data, validating the target, and executing a safe cutover.
Document current processes, rules, exceptions, and workarounds—and the business outcomes and controls they support.
DECIDE WHAT TO RETAIN OR REIMAGINE
Separate essential processes and controls from obsolete features, defects, duplication, and workarounds.
Translate operator intent into shared process designs, requirements, architecture, tests, training, and operating procedures.
Map integrations and shared data, then resolve dirty, duplicate, incomplete, and inconsistent records before migration.
Run UAT while legacy and modern modules coexist, reconciling results and validating end-to-end behavior across both environments.
Sequence data and user migration, manage rollback and controls, and protect ongoing operations through the transition.

exact_text_nodes: What modernization can unlock for the business
Modernization can change how the business grows, operates, and serves people.
New markets, products, channels, and acquired customers
Less manual work, fewer errors, shorter cycles
Supported technology, stronger controls, less fragility
Faster integration, governed APIs and data, AI readiness
Retire licenses, duplicated platforms, infrastructure, and legacy support burden
Select the outcomes that fit the business context, then connect each to a measure and a specific capability.

exact_text_nodes: The catalyst determines why modernization matters now
SECURITY EXPOSURE OR AN END-OF-LIFE DEADLINE
Hear: unsupported technology, vulnerabilities, audit findings, vendor deadline
Measure: exposure, incidents, recovery risk, support horizon
Hear: manual work, duplicate entry, long queues, workarounds
Measure: cycle time, touches, exceptions, errors
Hear: slow launches, limited channels, acquisition complexity
Measure: time to market, delayed revenue, conversion, capacity
Hear: data, interfaces, rules, or controls block AI-enabled workflows
Measure: blocked use cases, manual decision load, control gaps
Hear: critical rules and support knowledge sit with a few people
Measure: concentration risk, retirement horizon, recovery time
A LICENSE OR PLATFORM EVENT FORCES A DECISION
Hear: renewal, forced upgrade, expensive customization, vendor product change
Measure: five-year cost, renewal exposure, break-even
Hear: scarce legacy skills, expensive contracts, heavy incident burden
Measure: support labor, contract cost, incidents, enhancement cost

exact_text_nodes: Example: quote-to-cash modernization requires untangling the full ecosystem
ILLUSTRATIVE CURRENT STATE — FRAGMENTED POST-ACQUISITION QUOTE-TO-CASH
Customer hierarchy does not match either ERP
Differentiated contract, bundle, discount, and approval logic
Partner-specific mappings bypass the nominal workflow
Original customer, product, order, inventory, and invoice model
Operators route exceptions and repair failed orders
Different identifiers, tax logic, and fulfillment states
Duplicated entitlement and incomplete order visibility
Inconsistent measures and delayed exception visibility
Approvals, matching, corrections, and reconciliation. Operators often serve as the missing integration layer.
Modernization scope includes applications, platforms, integrations, data, business process, and human handoffs.
The same business capability is split across platforms, custom logic, point integrations, manual workarounds, and inconsistent data.

exact_text_nodes: Software modernization is an AI-age imperative
Constant AI innovation is making modernization faster, easier, cheaper, and more necessary than ever — raising the cost of delay and the premium on agentic readiness.
Prepare for the agentic future—or fall behind

Delay creates four compounding risks: moat erosion by AI-native disruptors; structural cost disadvantage as competitors automate operations; slower innovation; and loss of relevance in agent-led ecosystems.
Start with the value thesis, not the technology path
Treat modernization as an investment thesis tied to strategic advantage, measurable outcomes, lifecycle economics, resilience, and the cost of inaction.
Compress understanding before committing the path
Surface undocumented code, hidden dependencies, knowledge gaps, and business–technology misalignment to decide what to modernize, how, and in what order.

exact_paragraphs.text:
The longest, riskiest step is understanding what to modernize, how to do it, and in what order.

Organizations who don’t have the bandwidth or AI expertise often spend months analyzing the current state and then make conservative, suboptimal decisions to avoid risk. The result is a slow, expensive program with limited business impact.

exact_text_nodes: Modernization succeeds when people, process, and technology advance together.
West Monroe integrates all three lenses—supporting adoption, reimagining the work, and preparing a technology posture that can keep pace with accelerating change.
Reimagine how work gets done before changing the systems that support it.

• Assess workflows, handoffs, controls, and friction
• Design simpler processes around measurable business outcomes
Process reimagination grounded in business outcomes.
Bring employees and leaders into the journey so the new capability is adopted and sustained.

• Assess change impacts and readiness early
• Build roles, skills, training, ownership, and adoption into delivery
Change assessment and support from design through adoption.
Create the architecture and delivery posture to keep pace with accelerating change.

• Choose the right modernization path and sequence
• Build secure, resilient, maintainable platforms

Based on your current progress, we can rationalize applications and define the modernization strategy or get started directly with execution.
Prioritize application list and understand costs, roadmaps, and planned changes
Determine initial understanding of business value, technical health, and risks per application, and the enterprise architectural strategy
Interview application owners, evaluate app technologies for pain points and risks, create and socialize initial dispositions
Prioritize key modernization targets and document modernization roadmap
For priority apps, define future-state architecture with interim phases as necessary, contributing to product business case and plans that de-risk business impact.
App Disposition, Modernization Roadmap, Conceptual Architecture
For priority applications to be modernized, document backlog of requirements
Plan and execute iterative design & build sprints accelerated by GenAI to upgrade/rebuild features using the modern tech stack
Conduct QA and facilitate UAT of the modernized software
Conduct releases of the modernized application per release plan, prioritizing side-by-side releases of the legacy and modern experiences where needed
Continuously transfer knowledge to client team about the new codebase and supporting tools/processes; document in Enablement Playbook.
Iterative releases of modernized software, Developer Enablement Playbook
Scan the codebase and generate system-wide structural and semantic understanding
System Inventory, Dependency Mapping, Business Semantics
Convert evidence into modernization reports, target-state direction, and execution planning.
Carry forward validated context, guardrails, and acceptance criteria into implementation.
Agent-Ready Context, Validation Criteria, Tool Integration

exact_text_nodes: Modernization follows a standard lifecycle from strategy through sustained value.
Rationalize, Build, and Sustain organize connected subphases, each with a clear purpose and value contribution.
Decide what should change and why
Define the business outcome and questions that justify action.
Establish how work, systems, risks, and dependencies operate today.
Test future process and experience options before target design hardens.
Select dispositions, economics, roadmap, and the first investable wave.
Turn high-level plans into target processes, architecture, and working prototypes.
Create bounded software and integration increments from approved rules and decisions.
Prove parity, controls, performance, and acceptance with traceable evidence.
Move data, operations, and people through controlled release waves.
Establish ownership, service levels, observability, security, and cost control.
Keep knowledge and the product backlog current so the capability improves with measured performance.
FOUR THREADS SHAPE EVERY PHASE GATE AND DELIVERY DECISION

West Monroe recommends starting your modernization initiative with an effective Rationalization phase that lays the groundwork for what follows.
Prioritize application list and understand costs, roadmaps, and planned changes
Determine initial understanding of business value, technical health, and risks per application, and the enterprise architectural strategy
Interview application owners, evaluate app technologies for pain points and risks, create and socialize initial dispositions
Prioritize key modernization targets and document modernization roadmap
For priority apps, define future-state architecture with interim phases as necessary, contributing to product business case and plans that de-risk business impact.
App Disposition, Modernization Roadmap, Conceptual Architecture
Define the priority backlog and future-state design
Execute iterative build, QA, UAT, and controlled releases
Transition users, operations, and ownership without disrupting the business
Transfer knowledge and establish the modern delivery toolchain
Modernized releases, validation evidence, transition plan, Developer Enablement Playbook
Scan the codebase and generate system-wide structural and semantic understanding
System Inventory, Dependency Mapping, Business Semantics
Convert evidence into modernization reports, target-state direction, and execution planning.
Carry forward validated context, guardrails, and acceptance criteria into implementation.
Agent-Ready Context, Validation Criteria, Tool Integration
Track business value, reliability, security, and adoption
Operate and improve the modern capability through product and platform roadmaps
Retire legacy systems, contracts, and operating cost
Benefits tracking, operating model, improvement backlog, decommission plan

Source code, components, data, integrations, controls, dependencies, and confidence.
Process steps, rules, exceptions, users, outcomes, and pain points linked to technology.
Approved outcomes, architecture choices, open questions, and expert rationale with provenance.
Connect the evidence so an agent can traverse the work:
Bounded retrieval • source links • versions • approvals • permissions • uncertainty
Generate options grounded in current behavior, constraints, and target outcomes.

exact_text_nodes: Intellio Evolve turns application evidence into modernization guidance and sequencing

Evolve treats evidence as more than reports: source code, dependency and call graphs, data use, integrations, and functional boundaries. It uses that evidence to recommend modernization options and a sequenced starting point for human review.
Inventory source code, languages, frameworks, files, calls, dependencies, data use, integrations, components, and functional boundaries.
Translate evidence into modernization options, target-state considerations, risks, dependencies, and candidate work packages.
Suggest where to start and how initiatives may sequence based on coupling, blast radius, feasibility, and value—while preserving assumptions and uncertainty.
Recommendations are transparent, reviewable starting points—not final decisions.
Product managers and architects validate context, weigh business priorities and constraints, and guide the final modernization roadmap. Evolve accelerates judgment; it does not replace it.

exact_text_nodes: Evolve builds an evidence base during Rationalize, runs analysis workflows, and develops a context database used during the Build phase.
A connected journey from source-backed findings to business-owned decisions.
Repository scope, technology signals, available evidence, known uncertainty.
Set catalyst, outcome, criteria, business scope, measures, and the investment question.
Source inventory, structure, routines, calls, data use, dependencies, integrations, components, functional boundaries, coverage, and ambiguity.
Observe work, interview experts, assess process, business value, risk and cost, and validate what findings mean.
Validated current behavior and constraints available to selected functional specification and workflow or wireframe activities.
Choose what to preserve, remove, redesign, automate, buy, or build. Test target process, experience, architecture, and value hypotheses.
Source references, dependency and impact evidence, reports, scenarios, and planning artifacts.
Select dispositions, build the business case, set roadmap and governance, and approve the first viable wave.
Evolve builds the technical and functional evidence layer. West Monroe and client experts connect that evidence to business intent and make the modernization decisions.

exact_text_nodes: From security scan findings to a reviewable remediation plan
Structured CVE or scanner findings  •  relevant source repository and Evolve evidence store  •  component, dependency, integration, and business-criticality context
Organize findings, affected packages or components, severity, scanner evidence, and missing information.
Map candidate issues to source-linked components, dependencies, code paths, integrations, and potential blast radius where evidence supports it.
Flag supporting evidence, possible duplication, uncertain reachability, compensating controls, and false-positive questions for a security specialist.
Consider severity with business criticality, exposure, dependencies, operational risk, and cost of delay.
Produce a reviewable package with evidence links, affected areas, candidate actions, sequencing, validation tests, estimation questions, and owners.
Security and engineering specialists confirm applicability, exploitability, remediation, testing, and risk acceptance.

The audited product accepts structured CVE inputs and includes a triage handler and artifact outputs, but the default production runner is unavailable. Position as a pilot until the product owner confirms a production-ready execution path and evidence from real use.

exact_text_nodes: Evolve context supports Build and Sustain
Source-linked context can carry approved evidence forward when each task retrieves only what it needs.
Governed retrieval connects the foundation to bounded work.

Retrieve relevant process, rules, requirements, source references, components, data, integrations, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and open questions for a bounded design, coding, testing, migration, or cutover task.
Warmer handoffs, less repeated discovery, faster prototyping, more targeted agent prompts, stronger traceability, earlier identification of impacts and gaps.

Connect bug reports and feature requests to documented intent, process behavior, architecture, dependencies, prior decisions, tests, and operating knowledge. Support impact analysis, code investigation, regression-test maintenance, documentation, and backlog refinement.
Faster investigation and change, better knowledge preservation, and a potential reduction in maintenance and evolution labor.
FUTURE OR PILOT CAPABILITY REQUIRING PROOF
The context layer compounds in value only when teams keep it current, governed, source-linked, and available through retrieval tools.

Our team has executed dozens of software modernization strategy and build engagements across industries.
East Coast Electric & Gas Utility: Energy & Utilities

Modernized client’s data staging platform administration app which was 7 years old. Rewrote core presentation layer from AngularJS to Angular, upgraded web servers, upgraded .NET API layer, and created DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

Created modernization strategy for decades-old COBOL application at the center of client’s business, which was hindering innovation and agility. Designed modern microservices architecture with implementation plan to decompose application and deploy services.
Fortune 200 Electric & Gas Utility: Energy & Utilities

Modernized a solar interconnection web app from AngularJS to Angular, improving maintainability and efficiency. Re-wrote pages using Agile methods, driving feature parity alongside stakeholder input. Executed a pilot phase with parallel legacy and modern UIs to ensure seamless business user transition.

Assessed and rewrote a critical customer-facing app ahead of an urgent AngularJS end-of-life deadline within five months. Conducted architecture reviews, built backlog, and led iterative development. Enhanced security and repeatable patterns with a modern codebase ready for future enhancements.

Transformed client’s app dev practices by refactoring core reservation system into microservices. Improve scalability through IBM Garage methodologies, Cloud Foundry, and Google Kubernetes Engine. Established end-to-end CI/CD pipeline in Jenkins to achieve instant blue/green deployments.

Our team has executed dozens of software modernization strategy and build engagements across industries.
Large Video Streaming Platform Provider: High Tech & Software

Worked with Billing & Subscriptions team to simplify platform management. Established domain model to promote shared understanding, modernized the platform architecture, and updated APIs to centralize business logic, improve test coverage, and enhance communications.
Construction Company Software Provider: High Tech & Software

Modernized client's PRO App, integrating AI to enhance operational efficiency and cost savings. Prioritized features to reduce maintenance costs, increase usability, and improve user productivity. De-risked initial $5 million investment and identified opportunities for significant productivity improvement.
Large Video Streaming Platform Provider: High Tech & Software

Collaborated with client teams to develop both iOS and Apple TV apps. Re-wrote and modernized the iOS app while simultaneously building the Apple TV app resulting in a successful rollout to millions of Apple TV users, with quick and efficient updates.
Insurance Management Software Provider: High Tech & Software

Modernized client's software to enhance performance and user experience. Prioritized key features, streamlined workflows, and integrated advanced technologies to drive efficiency and innovation. Achieved significant improvements in operational capabilities and customer satisfaction.
Identity & Access Management Provider: High Tech & Software

Created product modernization strategy through collaborative workshops and interviews while analyzing 1.2M+ lines of code. Identified 25 tech debt reduction initiatives organized into a comprehensive 2-year roadmap, with opportunities to free up 30K hours of annual developer capacity.
HR Compliance Software Provider: High Tech & Software

Transformed a leading compliance solutions provider's legacy platform by addressing slow report processing, limited integrations, and security issues. Our agile team modernized the system using Azure and AI/ML to automate tasks and streamline workflows, reducing tech debt and optimizing costs.

Our team has executed dozens of software modernization strategy and build engagements across industries.
Large Packaging/Shipping Materials Provider: Consumer & Industrial Products

Identified key modernization targets, accelerating shift to modern services. Architected custom Java Spring microservices tier, integrating with new and legacy systems. Embedded teams quickly revamped development processes for efficiency. Accelerated client's roadmap, paving way for system retirement.
Large Credit Reporting Agency: High Tech & Software

Transformed client's offer management by modernizing their outdated system. Embedded product and development team members to design and build a system that personalizes offers using user demographics. This cut publishing and update times from 6-8 weeks to under 24 hours.
Golf Club Owner/Operator: Consumer & Industrial Products

Assessed and remediated key issues in caddie booking system. Established reusable tests and metrics to measure improvement effectiveness. Implemented fixes over 10 sprints, achieving 10X performance gains. Updated to long-term support versions and added CI/CD with gatekeeping.

Assessed client’s tech landscape, identifying risks and scalability issues. Rationalized applications; developed future state architecture and roadmap. Established maturity framework for digital. Recommended initiatives to enhance data analytics, IT governance, and technology solutions.
Large Property & Casualty Insurance Provider: Insurance

Re-platformed the client's legacy, Windows-only applications to a cloud-first tech stack. Unified the customer experience by modernizing workflows and integrated five applications into a single solution. Simplified processes and improved access to support and pricing specials.

Modernized outdated architecture to reduce risks and enable faster releases. Implemented Agile delivery process. Created .NET Core microservice and Azure-hosted SQL database to decouple occupational health domain. Replacing ASP.NET web pages with React for improved user experiences.

Client needed to modernize a decade-old solution that powers workflows for solar interconnection across their six operating companies. The application’s AngularJS front-end technology was nearing end-of-life and slowing down development team efficiency.
How can we accelerate innovation and increase security maturity on our solar interconnection solution?

Assessed leading frameworks and recommended Angular based on key business priorities of maintainability, theming, and dynamic forms. Angular enhances maintainability with its opinionated defaults, facilitating quick project initiation and simplifying new developer onboarding. Additionally, Angular Material and
support dynamic theming and form generation, respectively, accelerating front-end development with robust components and JSON-based configurations.

Our team inventoried all existing pages, rationalized which pages should carry over to the new Angular UI, re-wrote them leveraging an Agile development process, and engaged business stakeholders to validate feature parity prior to final cutover.
Conducted pilot phase where the old and new UIs were running side by side in production to enable a seamless transition for the business.

paragraphs.text: Assessed leading frameworks and recommended Angular based on key business priorities of maintainability, theming, and dynamic forms. Angular enhances maintainability with its opinionated defaults, facilitating quick project initiation and simplifying new developer onboarding. Additionally, Angular Material and Formly support dynamic theming and form generation, respectively, accelerating front-end development with robust components and JSON-based configurations.

Our developers & Product Analysts got trained in IBM Garage methodologies to accelerate the transformation of American Airline’s application development. The Garage method excels at helping teams quickly design, build, and deploy an MVP to optimize the time to market. Operational excellence is key to the success of MVP. We emphasize on 100% test automation to get full code coverage.
How can we modernize our legacy reservation management system?
Refactored large parts of the reservation systems from a monolith to microservices
Utilized Cloud Foundry (open source PAAS) to manage their application platform independently of their IBM infrastructure
Implemented Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), a managed container service, to support horizontal scaling of their reservation system
Jenkins was used to set up end to end CI/CD pipeline shifting their delivery frequency from every 2 weeks to an instantaneous deployment capability using a blue/green approach.

exact_paragraphs.text: Client’s 20-year-old custom COBOL application is the “beating heart” of business operations, but the aging system and associated technologies have increasingly unpredictable negative impacts on customer/user experience and hamper ability to enhance digital experience. This solution prevented the client from developing new innovations due to complexity and technical debt. West Monroe was engaged to translate strategic objectives into an architecture and modernization roadmap to target cloud-based technologies and a microservices platform.

This solution prevented the client from developing new innovations due to complexity and technical debt. paragraphs.text: Client’s 20-year-old custom COBOL application is the “beating heart” of business operations, but the aging system and associated technologies have increasingly unpredictable negative impacts on customer/user experience and hamper ability to enhance digital experience. This solution prevented the client from developing new innovations due to complexity and technical debt. West Monroe was engaged to translate strategic objectives into an architecture and modernization roadmap to target cloud-based technologies and a microservices platform.

The WMP team are dedicated, smart, and always top-notch professionals.

End of life technologies put a spotlight on risks to a key customer-facing application, prompting a rebuild and

onto AWS. West Monroe was tasked with assessing the feasibility of their goal and investment required to do so. From there, West Monroe led the creation of the development backlog, developed the solution, led testing efforts, and supported the deployment.
How can we resolve customer security concerns due to end-of-life technologies? How can we move to the cloud?
Reviewed current state application architecture and desired future state; created backlog of epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria; prioritized backlog to meet project object and timeline.
Followed an Agile development methodology to build the solution in logical increments with business teams performing end user testing in parallel.

Removed aging and end-of-life technology from a critical customer-facing application while making significant improvements to application security and workflow without changing the project timeline or overall investment required.
Performed knowledge transfer and transition activities to ensure a seamless deployment and operation of the new solution.
West Monroe guidance helped establish repeatable development patterns so that future projects can deliver consistent results in a faster timeframe.

Improved knowledge and understanding of the application functionality and its implementation through user stories and coding practices, which will make it easier to support and enhance the application in the coming years.

Hulu was approaching the launch of Hulu Live TV and sought out West Monroe to guide their development teams and ensure a timely launch for both their iOS app

Our team co-located with the Hulu team in Santa Monica while working with their remote iOS team in Seattle. The two worked together to re-write their iOS app while building out their Apple TV app to support the launch of Hulu Live TV.
As part of the re-write, both apps were updated to use Swift instead of Objective-C. A reactive framework was introduced to better manage internal app state.
A significant update was also made to the iOS and tvOS CI pipelines to provide a faster, automated feedback loop for integration tests.
The team successfully rolled out the app to millions of Apple TV users and was able to make quick and efficient updates.

I'm very excited about the tech debt [remediation] project coming forward because I do believe there is much value that will be delivered.
Identified 30K annual developer hours in additional capacity to be gained through implementation of tech debt remediation plans
Identified potential for additional $5-$15M in top-line ARR growth over next 3 years through increased investments in product innovation via increased developer capacity

A leading provider of security and identity and access management (IAM) software was faced with challenges growing the business through product innovation due to challenges with technology debt. West Monroe analyzed the product architecture and source code via automated scans and conducted stakeholder interviews to identify opportunities to increase developer efficiency, reduce code complexity, and increase capacity for innovation. This approach identified critical pain points and actionable remediation activities with quantified value
What development opportunities can we capitalize upon to drive efficiency and top-line growth?
Conducted a full-day workshop to gain a comprehensive understanding of the business's current state and align project scope
Held over 25 hours of stakeholder interviews to review the code base in detail and identify key areas for improvement
Analyzed more than 1.2 million lines of code using advanced scans and technology to create detailed dependency maps
Identified 25 initiatives for addressing technical debt and developed a framework to evaluate the business impact of each initiative
Created a comprehensive 2-year roadmap for all initiatives, including detailed action plans and analysis of costs, duration, and resource requirements.

paragraphs.text: A leading provider of security and identity and access management (IAM) software was faced with challenges growing the business through product innovation due to challenges with technology debt. West Monroe analyzed the product architecture and source code via automated scans and conducted stakeholder interviews to identify opportunities to increase developer efficiency, reduce code complexity, and increase capacity for innovation. This approach identified critical pain points and actionable remediation activities with quantified value

The team was able to come up to speed quickly, identify areas of improvement for the solution along with creating thorough documentation to support the application going forward. The team was also able to understand the business quickly and work with end users to identify future needs.
The project de-risked an initial $5M investment

Client was seeking help to modernize their PRO App and relaunch it with a new user group. They also wanted help to evaluate their existing product strategy & roadmap against near-term business objectives.
How can we modernize our app and relaunch it in the market with a new user group?

Our modernization effort prioritized features that reduced maintenance cost, increased usability, and improved end-user productivity. The team took a Product-first mindset and relied on direct input from end users to prioritize epics.
We rationalized the PRO App to identify modular AI assets that can be re-used and deployed in various parts of the user Journey to improve the overall experience.
This project de-risked an initial ~$5 million investment and helped identify opportunities that, when implemented, could yield a significant improvement in productivity

Client's end user insurance agents were becoming data entry specialists, uploading documents and data required to provision insurance policies. This was slowing down the time to close or renew policies. Further, the existing product suite failed to engage users, lacking a modern mobile experience that allowed users to easily find content.
How can we modernize our codebase and experience to engage our users in a different way? How can insurance agents close/renew policies more quickly?

Conducted persona identification, product discovery, user journey mapping, and prototyping to evaluate and test approaches for simplifying agent interaction, ultimately finding that offloading data entry to customers was preferred and saved agent time

Modernized client's software by prioritizing key features, streamlining workflows, and integrating advanced technologies, resulting in enhanced performance, user experience, and significant improvements in operational capabilities and customer satisfaction
Assembled a multi-disciplinary team to build both web and native mobile applications, supporting modern agent/customer interaction and driving efficiency and innovation.

paragraphs.text: Client's end user insurance agents were becoming data entry specialists, uploading documents and data required to provision insurance policies. This was slowing down the time to close or renew policies. Further, the existing product suite failed to engage users, lacking a modern mobile experience that allowed users to easily find content.

Based on the time savings gained through the changes our team implemented

Client is a leading provider of affirmative action and compliance solutions which are backed by the advanced capabilities of a proprietary plan management platform. The legacy on-premise platform requires a technical redesign and modernization to address lengthy report processing time, limited integration with third-party systems (e.g., CRM, HRIS, etc.), duplicative functionality and complex user workflows, and security vulnerabilities arising from local desktop database calls.
How can we prepare for future acquisitive growth and expansion of our enterprise customer base?
Conducted 35+ interviews with internal users to document existing functionality & pain points
Assembled an 18-member agile product development team to design and implement the next generation plan management system to accelerate client’s time-to-market

Developed a roadmap to reduce existing technical debt by rewriting legacy systems using modern, cloud-based technologies (i.e., Microsoft Azure, OpenAI, etc.), including architecture to support future GenAI and Predictive Analytics use case implementation (i.e., predicting billing, cross-sell/upsell,

Designed and built a new platform that will simplify the plan management process, leverage AI/ML to automate highly manual tasks, and provide the foundation for future growth, using modern cloud infrastructure to automate current processes, enable high availability, and drive faster report processing
Optimized platform costs by leveraging cloud-native technologies (e.g., data storage, analytics, etc.) that only incur costs when in use without impacting application scalability

Client doubled in revenue during the pandemic and its systems were struggling to support the rapid growth. They needed a reliable partner that could scale their engineering team to meet deadlines.
How can we build a modern platform to replace our legacy apps?
We worked to identify portions of the client’s modernization roadmap to help accelerate adoption of a modern services architecture to enable more flexible user interfaces across multiple mediums
We helped architect a custom Java Spring microservices tier and integrate into new and legacy applications with a modern DataStax environment
West Monroe was able to embed teams alongside Uline’s teams and hit the ground running

The collective team was able to revamp development processes that ran in a more agile fashion and work across the full spectrum of Uline applications to modernize the underlying data and services to be application agnostic.

exact_text_nodes: Once complete with our team’s changes, the application yielded 10x performance gains.
The application was no longer able to scale, and the underlying technology was reaching versions no longer supported making it difficult to grow and maintain.
How can we fix critical performance and security issues in our critical caddie booking system?
Performed a deep technical analysis of code, databases, and infrastructure
Established reusable tests and metrics to identify performance bottlenecks and gauge effectiveness of improvements
Recommended remediations with estimates, then worked with Client to prioritize ~25 technical opportunities based on effort vs. value
Implemented fixes iteratively over 10 sprints and now providing long-term application support
Updated multiple versions to bring software versions back up to long term support
Added CI/CD with gate keeping to ensure standards and best practices were met going forward
Enabled nearshore team to support and maintain the application at much reduced rates over the long term

Our solution allowed the client to retire five legacy applications, with all workflows being supported through the new platform.

Client’s application footprint included several legacy, Windows-only, native enterprise applications. These applications required users to multi-task between applications to get their work done. Client brought in West Monroe to re-platform them to a cloud-first tech stack and integrate workflows across applications.
How can we modernize our tech stack and not require our users to multi-task between apps?
Reimagined the customer experience by harnessing technology, data, creativity, and innovation to develop a unified product that meets the client's needs and focuses on enhancing user workflows
Converted the existing solution to a cloud-based platform and conducted a deep-dive analysis to document and modernize complex workflows, ensuring a seamless transition to modern technology
Integrated 5 applications into a single cohesive solution by utilizing best practice UX patterns and modern UI, minimizing the need for extensive training on the new application

Simplified processes for customers by improving access to support and pricing specials, and streamlining the process for completing product orders, thereby transforming the overall business operations

The client sought to replace their legacy offer management system with a dynamic solution tailored to user demographics. West Monroe embedded a Product Owner to collaborate with the client’s team, designing and building a system that personalizes offers based on user data, significantly improving the offer experience.
How can we modernize our offer publication and update experience?
West Monroe assisted the client in replacing their outdated legacy offer management system with a modern, dynamic solution.
A Product Owner from West Monroe was embedded within the client's team to facilitate seamless collaboration and integration.
Together, they designed and developed a sophisticated system that personalizes offers by leveraging detailed user demographic data.
This tailored approach significantly enhanced the offer experience, boosting both accuracy and sales effectiveness for the client.

Client, a Community Bank in Kansas, faced shifts in their business model due to changes in the Financial Services Industry and interest rates. West Monroe also rationalized applications in Accounting and Compliance and developed a future state architecture and roadmap as part of the Innovation Strategy & Roadmap initiative.

Established a maturity framework to assess the client's current state across digital capabilities including governance, strategy, SDLC, data engineering, security, and infrastructure
Conducted a comprehensive review of the Bank's technology landscape, including in-depth interviews with key stakeholders to understand application relevance to business operations
Performed an IT spend and resource benchmark and identified recommendations to address risks, scalability issues, and gaps in the technology portfolio, processes, and organization
Developed a roadmap with key dependencies, milestones, and high-level cost estimates, along with future state solution architecture for Accounting and Compliance processes

Recommended initiatives that Increase focus on data & analytics capabilities to enable business users to efficiently access data to enable data-driven decision making, enhance IT governance and organization structure through implementing formal processes, and create and deploy technology solutions based on consistent guiding principles and architecture patterns
Provided advisory support for the Tech Steering Committee throughout the project duration

The West Monroe resources that have been assigned to this engagement have been outstanding.
The features span ordering/fulfillment processes and enabling functions like client settings across multiple applications and tech stacks
The WM team has provided great value in the organization and knowledge they bring to the table.

Client specializes in drug testing, employee background and occupational health screening, transportation compliance, and substance abuse training. Their dated monolithic architecture results in large, risky releases and presents challenges in upgrading specific domains.
How can we expand our occupational health offering while modernizing our architecture?
Performed an initial architecture deep dive phase to identify pain points and formulate an approach ahead of the build phase
Streamlined the implementation approach by instituting a more Agile design and development process than that of other vendors, significantly lowering the time to produce working, high-quality code
Split the occupational health domain apart from the on-prem monolithic back-end by creating a new .NET Core microservice and SQL database hosted in Azure
Currently revamping their current internal-facing and client-facing experiences, replacing ASP.NET web pages with React in the process

Will leverage Azure Data Factory to perform a one-time data migration to retire occupational health data in the legacy on-prem SQL Server database and have the Azure SQL database become the source of truth, updating downstream systems to pull from the new microservice

Intelligence tools help you understand the estate.
Intellio Evolve combines software intelligence with human-augmented practitioner expertise to determine what to change—and carry those decisions into execution.

Intelligence tools produce substantial portfolio and application intelligence. The remaining challenge is converting that intelligence into business-approved architecture, scope, sequencing, and implemented change.

Dots indicate relative comparative strength—not complete capability. The intelligence-tools column reflects representative software capabilities; Evolve reflects intelligence combined with practitioner-led guidance and execution support.

Intellio Evolve adds source-backed modernization understanding and decision-ready artifacts. The combined Evolve and West Monroe offer closes the value gap by adding expert architectural opinion, business-value alignment, bespoke gap analysis, approved scope and sequencing, and accountable support through execution. The intended buyer takeaway is: CAST gives me strong analysis assets, but Evolve and West Monroe tell me what to do with them and help me execute.
